content.text: {"info":"search_code no longer indexes source code (ADR-039); the code-embeddings collection was retired and graphify is the only code-understanding engine now. Use `graphify explain <symbol>` and `graphify affected <file>` for relationships and impact, `graphify query <symbol>` only with a real symbol name, `rg` for literal text, templates and QML, and `search` or `search_deep` for intent — that lives in the vault. This tool is scheduled for removal in the next revision of the MCP tools contract."}
